title: manga-translator-ui
summary: Desktop/Web UI fork of manga-image-translator; its documented JSON project-file/export format includes editable text regions, source/translated text and geometry. P5.4 has a read-only synthetic-shape adapter, not a real-export compatibility result.
documentation_observations: Project JSON uses source-image path keys and region text/translation/lines; project saving and translation sidecars are documented.
P5.4 adapter reads a source-shaped synthetic six-region JSON and maps to NB regional IDs; it does not invoke or modify upstream code.
Actual local image processing and text translation provider may be independent; privacy and model suitability are not inferred from a desktop GUI.
limitations: No actual upstream export has been imported by P5.4; app version, hardware, OCR quality, adult-content handling and outbound network behavior are untested. GPL-3.0 notice relates to the upstream code; dependent models and assets have separate licenses.
